actions.tooltip: Alt: build \\input -> case p1 input of Just r -> Just r; Nothing -> p2 input.

objects.tooltip: p1 : Parser a — primary alternative.  If it succeeds (or consumes input then fails, depending on the parser library), its result wins.
p2 : Parser a — fallback alternative.  Tried only when p1 fails without commitment.
Parser a — combined parser that succeeds whenever either branch succeeds.  Used to encode grammar disjunction (rule = a | b).
